pathState.scope: Original default C locale only. The original runtime initializes this locale pointer via FUN_4a005b98(0,0)+1. Other locale initialization and whole-program global relocation are not ported.

functions.label: arm_lsl64
functions.recoveryNotes: Preserve full SUBS/BPL decision and low-byte ARM shift counts; ordinary C shifts by >=32 are invalid.

functions.label: arm_lsr64
functions.recoveryNotes: Preserve full SUBS/BPL decision and low-byte ARM shift counts; ordinary C shifts by >=32 are invalid.

functions.label: arm_asr64
functions.recoveryNotes: Preserve full SUBS/BPL decision and low-byte ARM shift counts; ordinary C shifts by >=32 are invalid.

functions.label: multiply64
functions.recoveryNotes: Unsigned multiplication modulo 2^64; two input register pairs.

functions.label: divide_unsigned64
functions.recoveryNotes: Quotient in r0:r1, remainder in r2:r3. Denominator must be nonzero; original exception path is not ported.

functions.label: divide_signed64
functions.recoveryNotes: Signed magnitudes use the recovered unsigned helper. Preserve wrapped MIN/-1 result. Nonzero denominator required.

functions.label: divide_signed32
functions.recoveryNotes: Signed quotient r0, remainder r1. Avoid C signed overflow. Nonzero denominator required.

functions.label: copy_forward_endpoints
functions.recoveryNotes: Forward copy requires non-overlap. Move permits overlap, including identical pointers. Return endpoint pairs follow the original direction-dependent path.

functions.label: move_endpoints
functions.recoveryNotes: Move permits overlap, including identical pointers. Forward path returns end pointers. Backward path returns each original pointer plus (count&1) for count<=3 or (destination&1) otherwise: its final byte has no writeback.

functions.label: copy_preserving_destination
functions.recoveryNotes: Preserves original destination in r0; delegates to the recovered copy/move helper.

functions.label: move_preserving_destination
functions.recoveryNotes: Preserves original destination in r0; delegates to the recovered copy/move helper.

functions.label: fill_end
functions.recoveryNotes: Argument order is destination, count, fill byte. Returns destination + count, not the original destination.

functions.label: zero_aligned_end
functions.recoveryNotes: Shared fill tail, zero value. Destination must be four-byte aligned.

functions.label: zero_end
functions.recoveryNotes: Shared fill tail, zero value. Accepts byte-aligned destinations.

functions.label: utf16_copy
functions.recoveryNotes: ARM entry switches to Thumb internally. Copy includes the zero terminator; return original destination.

functions.label: utf16_find
functions.recoveryNotes: Pointer values appear as 32-bit integers in the recovered declaration.

functions.label: string_copy
functions.recoveryNotes: Assembly preserves r0. Correct void inference by retaining and returning original destination.

functions.label: string_compare_count
functions.recoveryNotes: Zero-byte detection mask is loaded from the original literal pool.

functions.label: string_copy_pad
functions.recoveryNotes: Calls the recovered zero-fill helper for padding. Negative counts return without copying.

functions.label: string_compare
functions.recoveryNotes: Preserve exact machine return bits, including aligned RRX/carry path, rather than substituting a generic strcmp.

functions.label: memory_find
functions.recoveryNotes: Test contract uses nonnegative counts within the mapped buffer.

functions.label: string_append
functions.recoveryNotes: Assembly preserves r0. Retain original destination across the inferred pointer increments.

functions.label: string_append_count
functions.recoveryNotes: Assembly preserves r0. Test contract uses nonnegative counts.

functions.label: memory_compare
functions.recoveryNotes: Compare exact unsigned-byte difference, including aligned word fast path.

functions.label: ctype_alnum
functions.recoveryNotes: Default C locale table; character domain -1..255. Preserve the 0x98 bitmask, not a boolean.

functions.label: ctype_space
functions.recoveryNotes: Default C locale table; character domain -1..255. Return bit zero.

functions.label: ctype_lower
functions.recoveryNotes: Default C locale table; character domain -1..255. Preserve byte values outside uppercase entries.

functions.label: ctype_upper
functions.recoveryNotes: Default C locale table; character domain -1..255. Preserve the explicit 0xdf exception.

functions.label: bounded_string_copy
functions.recoveryNotes: Return full source length; copy at most capacity-1 bytes and terminate when capacity is nonzero. Disjoint regions.

functions.label: bounded_string_append
functions.recoveryNotes: Return initial destination length plus full source length. Capacity must be positive; preserve no-write behavior when already full. Disjoint source/destination.

functions.label: path_parent
functions.recoveryNotes: Original slash/backslash scanning and repeated-separator behavior. Source and destination may be identical; otherwise disjoint.

functions.label: path_extension
functions.recoveryNotes: Nonempty source and disjoint destination; preserve the original scan and the final-dot special case. One readable byte before source is required by the original scan.

functions.label: path_filename
functions.recoveryNotes: Filename component must be at most 126 bytes so the original 127-byte temporary copy is terminated. Destination holds 128 bytes. Source and destination may be identical. Stripping uses the leftmost dot in the filename, as in the original.

functions.label: path_has_scheme
functions.recoveryNotes: Recognizes :// anywhere, matching the original substring search rather than a standard URL parser.

functions.label: path_join
functions.recoveryNotes: Capacity must be positive; disjoint source/destination. Preserve separator selection and forced termination when destination is already too long.

functions.label: path_normalize
functions.recoveryNotes: Default C locale; writable terminated input with accessible lookahead and sufficient original buffer space. Preserve URI prefix handling, drive/leading parent rules, trailing whitespace and slash removal, case option, and the original body-relative 127-byte truncation.

functions.label: path_resolve
functions.recoveryNotes: Uses relocated 128-byte global directory prefix initially /. Disjoint input/output; output capacity 128; prefix must terminate within 128 bytes. Absolute or scheme-bearing paths are copied directly; relative joined paths are normalized.
